log_text: BOP-STACK-01 was worked on 2025-03-03 for a routine function check after the rig move. A full pressure test was carried out to ensure all systems were operating within specified parameters. The job is not closed yet and is to be re-checked after 12 hours running. PR
DRAWWORKS-01, 17/03/2025, FLT-0802, brake pads worn beyond limit, new brake pads fitted. Fault came back and has been escalated to the OEM for support. SM
SHALE-SHAKER-01 had FLT-0704 showing for a torn screen on the bottom deck. Replaced the screen and tested OK afterwards and returned to service. Logged by James Okafor.

MUD-PUMP-02 had FLT-0417 showing up on the panel this morning, which turned out to be a worn liner causing low discharge pressure. I did a liner changed out and got the pressure back up to spec. The fault has cleared and the job is closed out. 14 March 2052, SM.

2025-03-02, maintenance was performed on DRAWWORKS-01 where the drive chain was running dry. I greased the drive chain to resolve the issue. The fault has cleared and the job is closed out. Logged by Tom Hallworth.
13/03/2025 TOP-DRIVE-01 FLT-0521 gearbox oil running over temperature gearbox oil change carried out the fix is temporary and a follow-up check is still needed next shift logged by Hallworth

March 10, 2025, I worked on SHALE-SHAKER-01, which showed fault code FLT-0719. The issue was the vibrator motor failed, so I replaced the vibrator motor. The unit is running but still waiting on parts to finish the job. Logged by MK.
BOP-STACK-01 worked on 14 March 2025. Fault code FLT-0633 showed for annular preventer element leaking. Annular element swap carried out and tested OK afterwards, returning to service. PR
DRAWWORKS1 experienced FLT-0815 due to drum encoder signal dropping out. Recalibrated the drum encoder and the fault has cleared, job closed out. 20/03/2025. Logged by Patel.

I worked on SHALE-SHAKER-03 today, 28 March 2025, after it showed fault code FLT-0719 on the panel. The issue was the vibrator motor failed, so I replaced the vibrator motor and got the unit back in service and running normally. Aisha Siddiqui logged this after a long shift, feeling relieved it was a straightforward fix.

March 27, 2025, I worked on SHALE-SHAKER-03, which had its screens blinded with sticky clay. I pressure washed the screens to clear the buildup, and after the cleaning, everything tested OK and the unit was returned to service. Kowalczyk
2025-03-21 MUD-PUMP-02 FLT-0417 liner worn discharge pressure low replaced the liner unit is back in service and running normally logged by Raman

BOP-STACK-01 underwent a routine function check after the rig move, and a full pressure test was carried out to ensure everything was in working order. No fault code was raised, but the results show the fix is temporary, so a follow-up check is still needed next shift. 14 March 2025, Sarah McAllister.
MUD-PUMP-01 had FLT-0417 showing liner worn and discharge pressure low. Fitted a new liner and tested the system. The fault has cleared and the job is closed out. 2025-03-13. Logged by Raman.
March 12, 2025, I worked on DRAWWORKS-01 and found the drive chain running dry. I chain lubricated it, but the problem persists and has been escalated to the maintenance supervisor. MK

On 2025-03-29, I worked on BOP-STACK-01, which showed fault code FLT-0610 indicating accumulator pressure low. I performed accumulator pre-charge restored to address the issue. The fault has cleared and the job is closed out. LE

2025-03-08 MUD-PUMP-03 was found with a suction strainer partially blocked with debris. The strainer was pulled and flushed to clear the obstruction. The unit is running but still waiting on parts to finish the job. Logged by Dev Patel.

On 29/03/2025, I worked on TOP-DRIVE-02 which displayed fault code FLT-0521 indicating gearbox oil was running over temperature. I drained and replaced the gearbox oil in an attempt to resolve the issue. The fault came back and has been escalated to the OEM for support. Logged by Sarah McAllister.

TOP-DRIVE-02 was serviced on March 22, 2025, due to FLT-0521, which indicated gearbox oil running over temperature. A gearbox oil change was carried out, and the unit is back in service and running normally. Logged by A. Siddiqui.

20/03/2025. Worked on SHALE-SHAKER-02 where screens were blinded with sticky clay. Washed down the screens to remove the buildup but it is beyond what can be done on site and has been escalated to onshore engineering. Logged by Okafor.
